details.description:
You’re bidding on a 45 × 60 cm STUDIO DI FORMA poster by Lombardia Automobili, featuring the 2012 Lexus LFA. The artwork is 100% unique combination of a detailed illustration of the car and our own layout and typography. A white frame and Perspex glazing are included; poster and frame are shipped together with care. 

Pale washi-grey paper, sweeping charcoal sound arcs and a red rising sun give the artwork presence across a room. The red LFA seen from three angles, its cabin and its technical details invite a closer look. Above a desk or in a garage lounge, it’s a conversation piece for anyone who knows what those three letters mean.

Lombardia Automobili is an independent automotive design house. This artwork is limited to 50 physical prints in total across all sizes, colour variants, framing options and sales channels. STUDIO DI FORMA is made for people who appreciate the design of a car as much as the way it drives.

The subject is the 2012 LFA, the carbon-fibre-bodied Lexus supercar built in a run of just 500 cars between 2010 and 2012. Its high-revving 4.8-litre V10, developed together with Yamaha, and the sound it makes made it a defining Lexus. This is the standard road coupe, not the Nürburgring Package.

Sheet size: 45 × 60 cm. Nominal assembled frame dimensions: 48 × 63 cm. This is a contemporary, retro-inspired studio edition.

An independent artwork by Lombardia Automobili, not affiliated with or endorsed by Lexus or Toyota Motor Corporation.
